views.name: sales_comparison
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    hfs_m.product_code AS product_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hfs_m.customer_code) AS unique_sales_2020,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hfs_m.customer_code) AS unique_sales_2021,
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT hfs_m.customer_code) - COUNT(DISTINCT hfs_m.customer_code) = 0
        THEN 0
        ELSE (CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT hfs_m.customer_code) - COUNT(DISTINCT hfs_m.customer_code) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT hfs_m.customer_code) * 100)
    END AS percentage_change
FROM
    hardware_fact_sales_monthly AS hfs_m
WHERE
    hfs_m.fiscal_year = 2020 OR hfs_m.fiscal_year = 2021
GROUP BY
    hfs_m.product_code
views.description: Calculate the unique product sales count for 2020 and 2021 and the percentage change.

views.name: sales_by_product_and_division_2021
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  hp.product_code AS product_id,
  hd.division AS division_name,
  SUM(hfs.sold_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly AS hfs
JOIN hardware_dim_product AS hp
  ON hfs.product_code = hp.product_code
JOIN hardware_dim_product AS hd
  ON hp.division = hd.division
WHERE
  STRFTIME('%Y', hfs.date) = '2021'
GROUP BY
  hp.product_code,
  hd.division
views.description: Calculate total sales quantity for each product within each division in 2021.

views.name: aggregate_top_products
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  hd.division AS "division_name",
  hd.product_code AS "product_id",
  AVG(hfs.sold_quantity) AS "average_quantity_sold"
FROM hardware_dim_product AS hd
JOIN hardware_fact_sales_monthly AS hfs
  ON hd.product_code = hfs.product_code
GROUP BY
  hd.division,
  hd.product_code
ORDER BY
  hd.division,
  hd.product_code
views.description: Calculate the average quantity sold for the top three hardware products within each division.

views.name: orders_by_region
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  t1."region",
  COUNT(t2."id") AS "order_count",
  SUM(t2."total_amt_usd") AS "total_sales_amount"
FROM "hardware_dim_customer" AS t1
JOIN "web_orders" AS t2
  ON t1."customer_code" = t2."account_id"
GROUP BY
  t1."region"
views.description: Groups orders by region to calculate sales totals and order counts.

views.name: top_sales_reps_per_region
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    r.name AS region,
    w.name AS sales_rep,
    SUM(wo.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales_amount
FROM web_region r
JOIN web_sales_reps w ON r.id = w.region_id
JOIN web_orders wo ON w.id = wo.account_id
GROUP BY r.name, w.name
ORDER BY r.name, SUM(wo.total_amt_usd)
views.description: Ranks sales representatives by total sales within each region, including ties.

views.name: faculty_salaries
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  t1.FacNo AS faculty_id,
  t1.FacSalary AS salary
FROM university_faculty AS t1
views.description: Select faculty members and their salaries.

views.name: rank_salaries
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    "FacRank" AS rank,
    AVG("FacSalary") AS average_salary
FROM university_faculty
GROUP BY "FacRank"
views.description: Calculate the average salary for each rank.

views.name: company_salaries_by_city
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    sd.CompanyName AS company_name,
    sd.Location AS city,
    AVG(sd.SalariesReported) AS average_salary
FROM
    SalaryDataset sd
GROUP BY
    sd.CompanyName,
    sd.Location
views.description: Calculate average salaries for each company in each city.

views.name: top_companies_by_salary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    sd.CompanyName AS company_name,
    sd.Location AS city,
    AVG(sd.SalariesReported) AS average_salary,
    AVG(sd.SalariesReported) AS average_salary_national
FROM
    SalaryDataset sd
GROUP BY
    sd.CompanyName,
    sd.Location
ORDER BY
    average_salary DESC
LIMIT 5
views.description: Rank companies by average salary in each city, then filter to top 5.
